results.hypothesis: To determine whether unsupervised anomaly detection methods using adaptive thresholding techniques inspired by Statistical Process Control (SPC) identify equipment degradation 15% earlier on average than fixed-threshold alarms in multivariate industrial sensor time series.
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: Fixed-threshold baseline using percentiles of reconstruction errors from unsupervised models (e.g., Isolation Forest or AE)
results.success_criteria: If the adaptive SPC-inspired thresholding approach detects degradation 15% earlier on average than the fixed-threshold baseline, the hypothesis is supported. If there is no significant improvement or if the fixed threshold performs better, the hypothesis is refuted.
results.notes: Adaptive thresholding did not improve detection time compared to fixed thresholding.
